UserAccount.title: User Account
UserAccount.description: Owner-only synced account metadata for multi-device CartAudit sync.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL from Google sign-in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account sync record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest account update.

UserPrivateProfile.title: User Private Profile
UserPrivateProfile.description: PII-isolated private profile storing verified user email.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when private profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when private profile was updated.

WorkspaceSection.title: Workspace Sync Section
WorkspaceSection.description: Native-map snapshot of one logical CartAudit state domain scoped strictly to a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this workspace section.

clientUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when client generated this sync snapshot.

deviceName.description: Browser/OS label of the syncing device.

writerSessionId.description: Ephemeral session ID to avoid self-echo loops on snapshots.

payload.description: Native Firestore Map containing the domain fields (no JSON strings).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when section document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync write.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: PII-isolated private document (docId: info) containing email.

/users/{userId}/workspace/{sectionId}.description: Multi-device synced CartAudit domain slices owned by userId.
